definitions.gloss: liquor store; sake shop; liquor dealer
definitions.explanation: A shop that sells alcoholic beverages, especially sake and other Japanese liquors. Can also refer to the person who runs such a shop.

examples.japanese: {酒屋|さかや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought sake at the liquor store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酒屋|さかや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The liquor store in front of the station has a good selection.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{通|とお}り→通り：01475_toori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}ながら→昔ながら：26817_mukashinagara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酒屋|さかや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{何軒|なんけん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There are still several old-fashioned liquor stores remaining on this street.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (sake, alcohol) and ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop, store). The ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ suffix is a common word-forming element for shops and their proprietors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒屋|さかや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy at a liquor store)
- ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酒屋|さかや} (the local liquor store)
- {酒屋|さかや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧ (liquor store delivery)

Traditional {酒屋|さかや} were neighborhood shops that primarily sold sake, beer, and other drinks, often providing delivery service. While many have been replaced by convenience stores and supermarkets, some survive as specialty shops with curated selections of Japanese sake and other alcoholic beverages.
